title: The Silent Courier
brief: October 11, 22:40. Courier Danny Ortiz is found unconscious behind the East Docks warehouse. His satchel is open. One package is missing: a sealed envelope containing a burner phone. Dispatch logged the drop as Northbridge Logistics, bay 4. The phone's call log — if you recover it — holds a number that does not yet mean anything. It will.
objectives: Decide what the number is worth

evidence.label: EV-201
evidence.name: Burner Phone #8821
evidence.source: Found in storm drain, East Docks alley
evidence.desc: A cheap flip phone with no SIM tray label. Call log shows one number dialed three times in the last week: a blocked line that rings twice and hangs up. The case is scratched with a single mark: 8821. Inside the battery compartment, a strip of tape holds a folded scrap — coordinates for bay 4, Northbridge.
interp: Someone wanted this phone in a specific hand — and someone else did not.

evidence.label: EV-202
evidence.name: Courier Dispatch Log
evidence.desc: Danny signed out at 22:04 for a single drop: 'NB-B4 / sealed / no signature required'. The client field is blank. Ruth says Northbridge never leaves the client blank. Someone filled the job by phone — a voice she does not recognize.
interp: The job was planted into the queue.
Northbridge's name is on the route, but not on the order.

evidence.label: EV-203
evidence.name: Dock Camera Still
evidence.desc: A grainy frame: a figure in a dark jacket takes a small package from a courier's hand and walks out of frame toward the alley. The courier staggers two steps and falls. The figure never looks at the camera.
interp: Danny was struck after the handoff — or during it.
The receiver wanted the phone more than the courier's silence.

evidence.label: EV-204
evidence.name: Leo Vance Receipt Stub
evidence.desc: A torn receipt for two coffees and a 'hold package — L.V.' note in the same hand. Leo claims he was only waiting for a friend. The friend has no name.
interp: He may not have been the one who hit Danny — but he was in the orbit.

evidence.label: EV-205
evidence.name: Danny's Statement (partial)
evidence.source: Hospital bed, brief window of clarity
evidence.desc: 'Guy said Northbridge. Paid cash to the desk. Phone was already on. He said don't look at the screen.' Danny loses consciousness again before he can describe the face.
interp: The phone was active before the drop.
Whoever ordered it did not want Danny reading the log.

start.t: I dispatch forty couriers a night. You think I track every sealed envelope?

n_where.t: On his route. Bay 4, Northbridge. He left at 22:04. He does not freestyle.

n_book.t: Came in by phone. Male. Calm. Said 'Northbridge bay 4, sealed, no signature.' Paid the desk fee in cash through a runner I never saw. Client field stayed blank. That never happens with real Northbridge jobs.

n_log.t: Here. Look at the blank client field. I told the night supervisor. He shrugged. People shrug a lot around Northbridge.

n_8821.t: I don't number phones. I number runs. If that thing was in Danny's bag, someone put it there on purpose.

start.t: I fix small problems for people who don't want paperwork. Tonight I was drinking coffee. That's the whole story.

opts.t: You were at the docks when Danny went down.
Confront him with the camera still.

break.t: ...Fine. I was supposed to pick up a phone. Not hit anybody. The guy in the jacket got there first.

wrong.t: That picture is a shadow. You can't put a shadow in a cell.

n_docks.t: A lot of people were at the docks. I like the café. The coffee is terrible. That is also not a crime.

n_receipt.t: A friend asked me to hold something. The friend did not show. I kept the receipt because I keep everything. Habit.

n_nb.t: Northbridge pays well and asks fewer questions than the county. I don't work for them. I work near them. There is a difference you learn not to erase.

n_broke.t: The jacket guy took the phone and kept walking. I left. Danny was already on the ground. I don't do hospitals.

opts.t: Who hired you to hold the phone?
You're a witness now. Stay reachable.

n_hire.t: A voice. No name. Cash left at the café under a saucer. Same voice that books blank-client runs, if you ask Ruth. I never saw a face.

n_jacket.t: Dark. Expensive enough to not be dock work. Walked like someone who does not run. That is all I give you for free.

start.t: ...Hurts to talk. Guy said Northbridge. Paid cash. Phone was already on. Said don't look at the screen.

n_face.t: Hood. Shadow. I was looking at the bag. Stupid.

n_phone.t: It rang once while I was walking. I didn't answer. Orders.

lines.t: Rain on concrete. A courier bag open like a mouth. Danny Ortiz is already in an ambulance by the time you arrive.
Ortiz is alive. Barely. Package missing — one sealed envelope, logged as a Northbridge drop. Hale wants this quiet. I want it accurate.
Quiet and accurate rarely travel together.
Then pick accurate. Dispatch is Ruth Kline. There's a fixer named Leo Vance who hangs around the café. And the alley has a storm drain that eats evidence.

phases.title: EAST DOCKS

options.label: Café Hold
options.sub: Leo Vance — if he is still there

phases.proceedLabel: Call it in — enough to move
phases.proceedHint: Recover the phone and the dispatch log before you close the loop.

lines.t: Water, oil, a plastic edge. You reach past the grate.
A flip phone. Scratched case. The number 8821 cut into the plastic.
Scuff marks at shoulder height. Someone was pushed or fell hard.
Empty compartment where a sealed envelope should sit. No blood on the strap. The violence was efficient.
The still at 22:18: handoff, then collapse. The receiver never shows a face.
Northbridge's own log shows no official inbound at 22:00. The name was borrowed.

phases.prompt: You have phone #8821. The call log points to a blocked line that will matter later. What do you do with the number now?

options.label: Log it officially — full chain of custody
options.desc: Emma gets the log. The record is clean. Someone watching the record will see you looking.

options.label: Keep a private copy — official log stays thin
options.desc: You photograph the log and file a thinner report. Harder to trace. Harder to prove later.
effects: note:Private copy of #8821 call log — Oct 11

options.label: Press Leo for the voice — hard
options.desc: Drag Leo in as a material witness. He talks or he sits.

lines.t: Danny Ortiz survives. The phone is in evidence — or in your pocket's shadow. Northbridge's name was used as a mask.
I'll write the drop as theft and assault. The blank client field stays in the file. Hale will hate that sentence.
Let him. Numbers have a way of coming back.
Burner #8821 is now part of the record you keep. It will surface again.

completeEffects: msg:UNKNOWN|You opened something that was sealed for a reason. — 404
